stdout:
usage: gdd [-h]
           {init,validate,view,workflow,graphify,design-review,snapshot,context,boundaries}
           ...

GDD 0.2 and 0.3 model tools

positional arguments:
  {init,validate,view,workflow,graphify,design-review,snapshot,context,boundaries}
    init                Create a valid, unready GDD 0.3 project draft
    view                Generate an offline interactive GDD graph
    workflow            Prepare packets and coordinate existing development
                        agents
    graphify            Import, verify, recover or propose from Graphify
                        observations
    design-review       Check an advisory review's structure and current
                        applicability

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
